item.title: Lion vs Crocodile: The Truth Scientists Finally Confirmed!
item.description:
Lions and crocodiles rule two completely different worlds — but when those worlds collide at the water's edge, one of them is badly out of its depth. New research finally settles the question science avoided for decades.
What you'll discover: - Why a lion's only real weapon is useless in the water - The one terrain where the crocodile is almost unbeatable - What actually happens when a pride meets a Nile crocodile - The surprising winner scientists confirmed from real encounters
Chapters: 0:00 Lion vs Crocodile face-off 0:15 Who actually wins? The truth scientists confirmed 0:45 What new research really found 1:30 The old assumption everyone believed
